description: Initial external Game Pack for the first live benchmark.

vision.notes: The pack uses positive/negative difference signatures constrained by normalized ROIs and identifies configured camera views from the in-game title. A recognized camera limits evaluation to its own candidates. User-provided in-game screenshots are calibration references; the smoke evaluation is in-sample. YOLO, aligned candidate matching and general template matching remain disabled.

audio.notes: Relative loudness fields are supported by the core; classifiers are not included yet.
